subject: Unable to access AMBER home website

messages.author: Michael Shokhen
messages.body:
Dear AMBER experts!
I haven�t been able to access
the AMBER molecular dynamics website for four days:
https://ambermd.org/
In all my attempts to access the AMBER website
I receive the following response (see below).
What is happening there?
Does anyone know when the site will be available?
Sincerely,
Michael
Unable to connect
An error occurred during a connection to ambermd.org.
* The site could be temporarily unavailable or too busy. Try again in a few moments.
* If you are unable to load any pages, check your computer�s network connection.
* If your computer or network is protected by a firewall or proxy, make sure that Firefox is permitted to access the web.
